items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier, DYNAMIC-BUDGET null-validated re-run of V3-EXQ-828a (per-arm-per-seed pilot sizing, 3rd calibration attempt)
items.note: DYNAMIC-BUDGET (sizing-mechanism, NOT static-number) re-run of V3-EXQ-828a's design (THIRD calibration attempt for this driver family: 827/827a/828 hardcoded 1500 eval-phase steps -> 828a static-bumped to 3600 -> 828b dynamic per-arm-per-seed pilot). Same six-arm design, patches, DVs, thresholds (SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR=0.02, COMPOSITE_MARGIN=0.15) as 828/828a. V3-EXQ-828 (weakens, 2026-07-29 governance, confirmed failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json) and V3-EXQ-828a (weakens, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-828a_2026-08-01, margin_vs_max=0.148 just 0.002 short of the 0.15 C2 threshold) both stay exactly as scored -- NOT retracted or superseded here. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-828a_2026-08-01 (confirmed, status=confirmed) diagnosed 828a's own null_validation.checked=False as the SECOND consecutive miscalibration (worst cell needed 14,648 steps vs the 3600-step static budget supplied, ~4x short; tau_max AND period_max vary substantially by seed, and period_max -- not safety_factor*tau_max -- is often the BINDING term for a rare-firing stream) and routed to /implement-substrate: 'a per-run dynamic pilot pass that measures actual tau_max before committing to a fixed eval-phase budget'. That fix landed as experiments/_lib/inv091_driver_defaults.compute_dynamic_eval_budget() (ree-v3 ea9c52272d, substrate_queue.json INV091-NULL-VALIDATION-RUN-LENGTH now status=implemented/ready=true; REE_assembly 1bf64e4c95). This is the FIRST consumer of that function -- grep confirmed zero prior consumers before this script was written. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is null_validation.checked computed against a PER-ARM-PER-SEED DYNAMICALLY SIZED eval-phase array -- never computed this way by any prior run (827/827a/828/828a all static); not recoverable by reanalysis. Proceeds to run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): counted 1 substrate_ceiling/non_contributory-category autopsy target for INV-091 (failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json), below the >=2 threshold -- brake does not fire (unchanged from 828a's own count). DESIGN: each of the six arms gets its OWN short pilot (INV091_PILOT_EPISODES=6 episodes) with that arm's OWN patch already attached (not just one shared per-seed intact-arm pilot) -- RATE_RANDOMIZED changes tick cadence directly (period_max is exactly what the autopsy found often binds) and MODE_DECORRELATED changes operating_mode's driving signal, so sizing those arms off an intact-arm pilot would risk the same failure via a different lever. The REAL pass then loops episodes until the recorded trace reaches the pilot-computed required_steps (capped at DYNAMIC_MAX_EVAL_EPISODES=400, ~60,000 steps at nominal length) rather than converting to a fixed episode count up front -- the module's own 'more robust still' recommendation, avoiding the exact nominal-episode-count conversion 828a's early-hazard-death terminations undercut. SMOKE (--dry-run, 2 warmup/2 pilot eps, 20 steps/ep, cap=10 real eval eps): all 6 arms x 3 seeds ran end-to-end with no crashes, verdict: PASS printed once per seed (3 total). The full pilot->compute_dynamic_eval_budget()->real-eval-loop call path was genuinely exercised (not stubbed) at toy scale: e.g. intact/seed=11 pilot saw 7 of 8 named streams go fresh (40 pilot steps), correctly flagged z_goal (1 fresh sample) and z_harm_a (saturated at the lag cap) as unreliable, applied the 1.5x unreliable-pilot multiplier (effective_multiplier=3.0 on a bare_plan_blocks_minimum of 320 steps = 960), and correctly fell back to the documented INV091_MIN_EVAL_STEPS_REQUIRED floor (2848, floor_applied=true) since 960 < 2848 -- a fully sane, well-structured, non-degenerate, auditable result, not a crash or a degenerate zero. All 18 cells hit the (expected, toy-scale-only) DYNAMIC_MAX_EVAL_EPISODES_DRY=10 real-episode cap (200 steps supplied vs a 2848-step requirement, honestly recorded as dynamic_budget_cap_hit=true rather than papered over) since 20-step dry episodes cannot reach a multi-thousand-step floor -- this is the documented, expected dry-run behaviour, not a defect; no PilotTooShortError fallback was ever triggered even at this toy scale (any_dry_run_pilot_fallback=false across all 18 cells). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 non-conforming (1 pre-existing advisory agent-seed-order WARNING, confirmed present identically in the 828a template -- not a regression). validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps, substrate_hash present. manifest carries null_validation_successor_of='V3-EXQ-828a' (informational cite, not supersedes -- none of 828/828a's evidence is invalidated) and complements=['V3-EXQ-827a','V3-EXQ-828', 'V3-EXQ-828a']. MINT: all six arms emitted reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False); fingerprints naturally distinct from 828a's (different eval_episodes_policy in config_slice), not a collision. estimated_minutes raised over 828a's 240 to account for the added per-arm pilot passes plus a real eval budget that can run well past 828a's fixed 3600 steps when a cell's measured tau/period genuinely demands it (up to the 400-episode/~60,000-step safety cap) -- a synthesis of INV-091's evidence must read this manifest ALONGSIDE V3-EXQ-827a's, V3-EXQ-828's and V3-EXQ-828a's, not in isolation.

items.title: INV-034/Q-021: goal-maintenance-vs-avoidance-only ablation (FULL vs AVOIDANCE_ONLY vs RANDOM, post-SD-012/MECH-306/SD-057)
items.note: IGW-20260801-222 (claim INV-034, backlog EVB-0242, companion claim Q-021). Prior draft-only design pass (session frosty-satoshi-2e7cbc, DESIGN.md + STATUS_AND_OPEN_QUESTIONS.md) found three prior lineages tried this exact shape and all failed at the same prerequisite: v3_exq_085/085c/085d/085e (INV-034, 2026-03-23/24), v3_exq_072b_q021_behavioral_flatness (Q-021, self-marked evidence_direction=superseded), v3_exq_331_arc030_approach_avoidance_balance (ARC-030, non_contributory -- Go sub-channel made zero difference, not a crash). That prerequisite (z_goal never seeding / seeding collapsing at contact) is now resolved: SD-012 drive-scaled seeding + MECH-306 drive_floor fix (V3-EXQ-582a PASS) + SD-057 object-bound incentive salience (V3-EXQ-514o PASS) closed goal_pipeline GAP-1 through GAP-7 by 2026-06-15. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b) checked live 2026-08-01: zero failure_autopsy_*.json targets tag INV-034/Q-021/ARC-030 -- brake does not fire. claims.yaml INV-034.evidence_quality_note 'hold pending architectural discussion of z_goal seeding' is stale relative to this. 3-arm ablation (FULL goal+avoidance vs AVOIDANCE_ONLY goal_weight=0.0 vs RANDOM baseline), current validated knobs (drive_floor=0.9, drive_ema_alpha=1.0 per MECH-306). Lightweight direct-REEConfig harness used (draft's 'Option A'), per default instruction -- nothing in current repo state showed it broken for a similar claim; the full scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum ('Option B') is the documented fallback if a real run's G0 non-degeneracy gate fails, exactly as it was for goal_pipeline GAP-2 historically. G0 non-degeneracy precondition (Q-021's own pre-registered requirement) gates the whole run to non_contributory rather than a false weakens if FULL itself comes in flat; C1/C2 hold harm-avoidance and survival comparable between arms as the agency-vs-competence control (MECH-180 death-vs-quiescence guard); C3-C5 test the predicted quiescence/entropy signature; C6 is a mechanistic z_goal-engagement check. API re-verified 2026-08-01 against live ree_core/ source (skill Step 3) -- FOUND AND FIXED a real bug the draft had flagged as unconfirmed: the draft's z_goal read (getattr(agent,'z_goal',...) or getattr(agent._current_latent,'z_goal',...)) was wrong on both branches (REEAgent has no .z_goal; LatentState carries no z_goal field) and would have silently zeroed the C6 mechanistic check for both arms; fixed to read agent.goal_state.z_goal (GoalState.z_goal property), confirmed live in agent.py/goal.py. Also added arm_results/arm_cell fingerprinting (mint-as-you-go default, not requested for reuse), z_goal_stream wiring via ZGoalStreamAccumulator, and a fresh-selection-vs-hold-weighted entropy split (policy_entropy_fresh_select, diagnostic-only) after validate_experiments.py flagged the realized-action policy_entropy (load-bearing C5) as a hold-weighted-E3-readout advisory -- C5 stays gated on the realized/behavioural statistic (matches INV-034's own 'does nothing' language) with the fresh-select figure recorded alongside for triage. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings (clean after the fixes above). Smoke test (--dry-run): all 9 seed x condition cells (3 seeds x FULL/AVOIDANCE_ONLY/RANDOM) ran to completion, verdict PASS x9, manifest written+relocated out of evidence/ correctly, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.087 writer_calls=287 writer_defect=False (confirms update_z_goal is live and correctly wired), G0 correctly self-routed FAIL/non_contributory on the tiny toy-scale dry run (3 episodes) as designed -- not a bug. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (resource_visit_rate / z_goal_norm_at_contact under a FULL-vs-AVOIDANCE_ONLY-vs-RANDOM ablation on the post-SD-012/MECH-306/SD-057 substrate) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- the three prior lineages predate the substrate fix and carry no substrate_hash; not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. Does not supersede any single prior ID (085/072b/331 all pre-date the fix).

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here. NOTE (observed at queue time, 2026-08-01): the current experiment_queue.json snapshot shows V3-EXQ-858 status='claimed' on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, not 'suspended' -- a coordinator-side hold/suspend action may not be reflected in this git-derived queue view (holds are coordinator-side per CLAUDE.md 'Phase-3 queue lever depends on op'); flagged for the user/governance to reconcile, not resolved by this queue entry. Code review (Step 3.5): script is a near-verbatim merge of V3-EXQ-859's agent config + MECH-448/449 latch-cleared readout (copied unchanged) with V3-EXQ-851's P0/P1/P2 phase structure + REINFORCE bias-head training machinery (copied unchanged, constants LR_LPFC_BIAS/ REINFORCE_BATCH_SIZE/OUTCOME_BUF_MAX/POLICY_TEMPERATURE/ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD/EMA_DECAY reused verbatim from 851). claim tagging, diagnostic adjudication (one readiness precondition, measured/threshold/met, load_bearing sample_adequate criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for both mechanisms), substrate API correctness, latch-clearing, progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=350 the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*arm = 6 lines, Seed/ Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through) all verified against current source. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = MECH-448/449 engagement under lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source at FULL training budget, matched seeds. Checked: V3-EXQ-851 tested lateral_pfc alone (matched constant, not swept) at full budget; V3-EXQ-859 tested the lateral_pfc-vs-none sweep but only at SHORT budget (P0=10 vs this run's P0=200); no manifest anywhere sweeps route_source at matched seeds AND full training budget. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. See REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md (+.json) for the full autopsy this replication answers, and experiments/v3_exq_859_arc062_lateral_pfc_route_mech448_449_ablation.py / experiments/v3_exq_851_arc062_pa_lateral_pfc_route_source_gapfanout.py for the two scripts this one merges.
